selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What main teaching is explained in this section?
questions.answer: It explains that everything Allah creates has beauty, either in itself or in what it leads to.

questions.question: How can something that looks ugly still be beautiful?
questions.answer: Its outer appearance may seem unpleasant, but underneath it may contain wisdom, order, and good results.

questions.question: How is autumn’s destruction presented in a positive way?
questions.answer: It removes small creatures from their duties before winter hardship and prepares the way for a fresh spring.

questions.question: Why do people often judge events as ugly?
questions.answer: They focus on what appears on the surface and think mainly about themselves.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number of aims in events that seem harmful?
questions.answer: Even if one aim relates to people, many more aims relate to their Creator.

questions.question: What lesson is taken from hawks chasing sparrows?
questions.answer: Though it seems harsh, it helps bring out the sparrow’s abilities.

questions.question: How does the passage connect self-centeredness with poor manners in judgment?
questions.answer: A person who judges everything only by his own point of view may call proper things improper.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the Qur’an’s style in speaking about such matters?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an speaks with true politeness and proper conduct because it considers the right angles and veils.

questions.question: How does the passage describe things that seem disordered or confused?
questions.answer: It says they may actually be orderly and sacred in reality.

questions.question: What final conclusion does this section reach about apparent disorder?
questions.answer: What seems chaotic may actually be meaningful, orderly, and sacred.

questions.question: Which Qur’anic idea is this section helping to explain?
questions.answer: It explains that Allah creates all things in the best way.

questions.question: What is essential beauty?
questions.answer: It is beauty found in a thing itself.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention ugly-looking and confusing events?
questions.answer: To show that what seems unpleasant may still contain hidden beauty and order.

questions.question: What positive role does autumn play, according to the passage?
questions.answer: It ends certain living duties, protects small creatures from winter suffering, and opens the way for renewal.

questions.question: How do difficult events help hidden abilities?
questions.answer: They cause sleeping potentials to emerge and grow in a beautiful way.

questions.question: What is missing when a person looks only at the outer side of events?
questions.answer: He misses the wider wisdom and the many meanings connected to Allah’s names.

questions.question: What does the sparrow example teach about hardship?
questions.answer: A difficult pressure may help reveal and strengthen abilities.

questions.question: What does the passage say causes people to think some proper matters are improper?
questions.answer: Their worship of outward appearance and their habit of judging only from a human-centered view.

questions.question: What is said about the Qur’an’s expressions in this area?
questions.answer: They are described as fully proper and refined because they match the wise and purposeful sides of things.

questions.question: What kind of reader response does the passage seem to ask for?
questions.answer: It asks for wisdom, patience, and trust in Allah’s wise design.

questions.question: What central idea ties the whole passage together?
questions.answer: The central idea is that things should not be judged only by how they look, because hidden beauty and wisdom may lie beneath.

questions.question: What two ways of being beautiful are described?
questions.answer: A thing may be beautiful by its own nature or by the good outcomes it produces.

questions.question: How does spring illustrate this hidden beauty?
questions.answer: The rough features of the season help bring out colorful flowers and organized growth.

questions.question: In what way are winter hardships connected to divine power in the passage?
questions.answer: They are presented as displays of Allah’s majesty and strength.

title: 2 Point True Beauty in Everything and Wisdom Behind the Veil
